scope: Local implementation progress on the existing PTQ1 release blockers. No original authoring authentication, complete public reconstruction, actual-model acceptance, independent human verdict or full promotion is supplied. Later documentation/evidence commits do not change the checked production/test code.

changes.result: Public reconstruction retains an exact finite six-file replay-source bundle and manifest bound into the attempt/report before input downloads. Independent replay reads that bundle as data, checks its inventory and identities, preserves legacy support and never executes archived producer code. Bounded fixed validation reasons survive a rejected attempt.

Parsed archived recipe pins must equal independently selected active recipe pins while raw archived bytes remain bound to their original digest. Self-consistent substitution of public model/config pins cannot pass.

Failed, reset and cancelled service reads and the Stop-prefix path retain one-pass response-prefix hashes/counts, bounded numeric header/status observations and fixed transport classifications. Raw bodies and headers are not retained. Work, deadlines, cleanup, power paths and pass predicates remain unchanged.

One typed native admission guard replaces duplicated producer/intake predicates. Hosted preparation requires parsing all nine actual workflow PowerShell blocks plus the launcher, thirty-six receipt/output fixture cases and two exact guard regressions before production checks. Schema-2 packages require five hashed files plus receipt.json, including the guard and source-bound workflow-contract receipt.
All five new transport controls are required by hosted acceptance before publication; replay and five-file acceptance contracts are documented.

correctionsBeforeValidation: Replaced an invalid bool method in the new guard before any compile/test.
Tightened malformed HTTP status classification and covered it in the existing new control.
Required archived recipe equality against independent active pins after identifying the substitution gap.

localValidation.durationSampleScope: Sampled after retaining the raw payload and manifest, before writing the final small retention.json metadata file. Its own write is not included in that sample; no later measurement is substituted for the original clock.
limitations: Only the selected new controls and one legacy replay-boundary control executed. This was neither a complete suite nor an old failed validation retry.
The NumPy producer-bundle control, actual full public reconstruction, all-target application analyzers/linking and genuine hosted package production/intake remain pending.
Actual models, full numerical/context/output/resource/isolation/recovery/install behavior, per-prompt throughput and direct human quality/comfort acceptance remain unqualified.
The built guard remains an external local validation artifact. No installed application or maintenance executable was replaced.

power.interpretation: All original endpoints were battery operation with saver enabled; charge ranged from8 to7 percent. Local correctness passes supply no timing, energy or capacity benefit. Later observations are not substituted for these original endpoints.

implementationSubgatesLocallyVerified: Exact retained-source replay with independently selected recipe/payload identities and rejection of corruption/substitution.
Response observations surviving cancellation/reset without retaining private header/body text or qualifying incomplete framing.
Typed analyzer/output admission, exact-source contract completeness checks and native guard compilation/self-check.

remaining.ownerHostedPreparation: After the owner publishes the local main changes, run genuine exact-source Foundation and native-runtime acceptance preparation with run_device=false. Retain successful all-target application analyzers/linking, source-bound schema-2 package and independent review. Old schema-1 external helper selections are stale and not ready.
remaining.publicReference: Owner-run the already declared hosted all48 reconstruction exactly once and independently replay/review the retained artifact. No public model payload was downloaded or reconstructed locally.
remaining.authoring: Authenticate original checkpoint/invocation/toolchain and independent native writer mappings separately; new source retention and replay cannot establish missing original provenance.
remaining.device: Only after current-source hosted prerequisites and explicit owner selection, predeclare and execute a feasible current-release service/rollback workload with original power observations. The existing450s estimate/smallest ten-minute allowance is preparation, not an executed verdict.
remaining.broadPromotion: Retain complete device, human, benefit and clean-machine evidence and pass all nineteen exact-candidate gates. No broad gate closes merely because these local implementation subgates pass.
remaining.durableEvidence: Raw local receipts are retained here; owner-managed durable external backup and before-expiry capture of future hosted results remain separate.
